data.name: Narsi
data.gender_notes: Narsi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Narsi is the name given to the Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu. Narasimha is a man-lion incarnation of Vishnu, who is depicted as having the body of a lion and the head of a human. The name Narsi represents the power and might of Lord Vishnu in protecting His devotees from evil. The name Narsi carries the meaning “Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Narsi usually hope their child will grow to embody narasimha avatar of lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and protection from evil.
data.etymology: Narsi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narsi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Narsi carries significant cultural significance in Hinduism as it represents the powerful Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu. This avatar is depicted as a man-lion, with the strength and power of a lion and the intelligence and compassion of a human. The tale of Narasimha is widely known in Hindu culture and is an important part of the Mahabharata and other Hindu texts.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Narsi holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the protective and powerful presence of Lord Vishnu in the form of Narasimha. This avatar is known to have appeared on earth to protect His devotee, Prahlada, from the evil king Hiranyakasipu. The name Narsi signifies the strength and courage of the Lord in protecting His devotees from harm and offers a reminder of His unwavering love and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Narsi is a Sanskrit name meaning "Adorer of Narayana (Vishnu)". It symbolizes devotion, dedication, and surrender to the divine will. The one named Narsi is believed to be constantly in communion with the divine, seeking its guidance and grace in everyday life.
